notices: Using wildcard characters when filtering log messages
Disk logging disabled by default on some models
Upgrading from FortiOS version 5.0.9 or later
Upgrading from FortiOS version 4.3.16 or later

observations.description: FG-600C crashes during reboot during hardware switch setup.
Filter srcip and dstip do not work when device is faz.
DHCPOFFER is sent as broadcast from the DHCP server to the DHCP relay agent when the broadcast flag is set in DHCPDISCOVER.
The system does not restore interface configuration that references an invalid interface.
TCP packets are forwarded while a session is in tcp-half-open state.
New OpenSSL security advisory update.
After upgrading, the slave may fail to synchronize with the master due to the firewall service group.
FortiGate loses the connection to a FortiAP after reboot.
cw_acd daemon high memory issue.
DLP cannot detect files in Microsoft Outlook Web Access over HTTPS.
FortiGate may experience an HA failover issue caused by high CPU usage.
Users may experience a HTTPS transaction failure on a load balanced VIP in full SSL mode.
When the FortiGate unit experiences high CPU usage, IPsec VPN packets may be lost.
Traffic may not pass through a VLAN interface added to a link aggregation group (LAG) in a transparent mode VDOM.
observations.workaround: Run a diagnose sniffer packet on the physical interface in the transparent mode VDOM or reboot the FortiGate unit.

observations.description: IPsec VPN traffic throughput is highly unstable.
observations.workaround: Do not use IPsec VPN over a 40G LAG.

observations.description: FG-3700D: LAG groups configured on low latency interfaces (port25 to port32, and NP6_0 to NP6_1) do not function correctly.
observations.workaround: Only use either low-latency-mode or LAG for traffic on these interfaces.

observations.description: IP tunneling (SIT tunneling) does not work when offloaded to NP6.
observations.workaround: Disable auto-asic-offload in SIT tunnel configurations.

observations.description: Reply traffic is not offloaded when shared traffic shaping is enabled on policies for accel-erated inter-VDOM links using the npu_vdom interface.
The link and speed LEDs remain on after shutting down the unit using the execute shut-down command.
The r8168 driver is unable to shutdown power of the port and will keep the link of the other end in an up state.
Hasync stops synchronizing the configuration due to a file descriptor exhausted issue.
The IPsec VPN may lose connectivity when connecting to the FortiGate Web-based Manager or SSH.
After enabling capability-default-originate, BGP will not insert the default route learnt from a different neighbor.
The initXXX daemon may cause high CPU usage.
Antivirus profile errors after upgrade from 4.3
A non-standard HTTPS page fails to load when passing through two explicit proxies.
The vulnerability scanner appears in the Web-based Manager and CLI when the FortiGate unit is in transparent mode. This feature does not work in transparent mode by design.
When using Microsoft Internet Explorer 9, created firewall policies are not displayed in the Policy page. The content pane toolbar is not displayed in this page.
An administrator with read-only permission is able to delete firewall policies.
A firewall policy may be deleted after a reboot if it uses an empty FSSO group.
